THE SPECNA ARMS SA-FH07 FLEX GEN.2 BLDC HAL ETU AEG REPLICA: AN ADVANCED ELECTRIC AIRSOFT RIFLE
The Specna Arms AEG SA-FH07 FLEX Gen.2 BLDC HAL ETU replica is an electric airsoft rifle designed for players looking for a cohesive package, featuring high-end electronics integrated right out of the box. It combines a brushless motor, an electronic trigger with magnetic sensors, and a patented gearbox in a versatile carbine format, suitable for both CQB and outdoor play. Weighing 2,850 g and featuring an adjustable length from 805 mm to 890 mm, it offers a maneuverable platform without compromising on durability.
Construction and materials: reinforced polymer and metal
The main body of the SA-FH07 is made of nylon-fiber-reinforced polymer, with a textured surface and a matte finish that ensure a secure grip in all conditions. The components subject to the highest mechanical stress are made of metal: the flash hider, outer barrel, fire selector, unlock button, magazine release, pins, and sights. Internally, the gears are made of steel, and the polycarbonate piston is equipped with all-steel vanes, providing increased durability under repeated stress. The aluminum nozzle ensures optimal sealing for a consistent feed of BBs.
The Æther gearbox, featuring a reinforced frame and covered by European Patent No. 015044865-0001, forms the mechanical heart of this replica. It incorporates 8 mm ball bearings, angle-of-engagement (AoE) control, and a reinforced front plate. It is compatible with springs up to M140, making it a solid foundation for extensive customization without having to change platforms.
Brushless Motor and HAL ETU: Electronics Designed for Precise Trigger Response
The Specna Arms Dark Matter High Speed 27k brushless motor is one of the standout features of this replica. It offers a longer lifespan than a conventional brushed motor, high torque, and immediate response to trigger pull. It operates more quietly, which is noticeable during gameplay.
The ETU HAL (Electronic Trigger Unit) system relies on magnetic sensors that detect trigger movement without physical contact, reducing mechanical wear on the trigger mechanism. This system allows for direct programming via the trigger, without tools, and offers a wide range of configurations: five trigger sensitivity levels, six adjustable pre-cocking levels, as well as several auto and semi-auto firing modes. The binary trigger fires when pressed and when released. A low-battery alarm rounds out the features. The replica is powered via a T-Dean connector and is compatible with 7.4V and 11.1V LiPo batteries.
TDC Magnus Hop-Up Chamber and ESA System: Adaptability and Precision Adjustment
The TDC Magnus hop-up chamber is a key component of this generation. It is adjusted from the top (Top Down Center), a patented design that ensures centered and stable pressure on the BB with every adjustment. It is paired with a Helium Flat Hop Eraser seal, designed to provide a uniform contact surface with the BB. The 6.03 mm inner-diameter barrel completes this hop-up assembly.
The ESA (Easy Spring Access) system allows for quick replacement of the main spring without the need for workshop tools. For a player who switches between different playing environments - indoors or outdoors - this is a tangible advantage: adjusting the replica's power can be done directly on the field or before the game, without complex disassembly. An additional M90 spring is also included.
Ergonomics and Field Setup: Versatile Use
The 6-position retractable stock, equipped with a rubber buttpad, allows the replica to be adjusted to fit the player's body type or protective gear. The bolt catch is functional, adding a realistic touch to handling procedures. The handguard is equipped with Picatinny rails to accommodate optics, flashlights, foregrips, or any other standard accessory. The outer barrel has a 14 mm counterclockwise (14 mm CCW) thread, allowing for the attachment of a compatible suppressor or tracer. The gearbox is V2-format, a widely used standard that facilitates access to replacement parts and internal modifications.

Weighing 2,650 g and featuring an adjustable length from 700 to 780 mm thanks to its 6-position telescoping stock, it offers versatility suitable for a variety of setups, from CQB to milsim.
Internal mechanics built to last
The SA-FH06's body is primarily made of nylon-fiber-reinforced polymer, a material that combines lightness and strength. The components subjected to the greatest mechanical stress are made of metal: the flash hider, outer barrel, slide, fire selector, and reload lever are made of aluminum or steel depending on their function.

The interior is based on the Æther gearbox, a V2 version developed by SPECNA ARMS. Its reinforced front panel, inspection and pre-cocking windows, as well as its integrated functions for releasing the main spring and adjusting the trigger, make this a gearbox designed for easy maintenance. The gears are made of steel, the slide bearings measure 8 mm, and the polycarbonate piston is equipped with fully steel vanes, ensuring greater durability than solutions that are partially made of plastic. The precision barrel has a diameter of 6.03 mm, and the hermetically sealed aluminum nozzle ensures optimal sealing with every firing cycle.
The Dark Matter brushless motor and HAL ETU Gen.2 electronics
The standard motor is the SPECNA ARMS Dark Matter High Speed 27k, a brushless motor. A brushless motor has no parts subject to direct friction wear, resulting in increased longevity, reduced heat generation, and quieter operation. Compatibility with this type of motor is natively supported by the HAL ETU Gen.2 electronics.

This electronic unit uses magnetic detection: the trigger position is read by magnetic sensors rather than mechanical contacts, which eliminates contact wear and improves trigger response. Programming is performed directly via the trigger, without any external tools. It offers 5 trigger sensitivity levels and 6 pre-cocking levels, allowing you to precisely tailor the responsiveness to your playing style.
The TDC Magnus Chamber and the ESA System
The rotating TDC Magnus Hop-Up chamber allows for precise and stable adjustment of the backspin applied to the BBs. It is paired with a Helium Flat Hop Eraser Hop-Up pad, designed to optimize the contact surface with the BB.

The ESA (Easy Spring Access) system allows you to replace the spring without specialized tools, right on the field if necessary. The gearbox is compatible with springs up to M140, opening the door to a variety of configurations. An additional M90 spring is also included. The battery is housed in the stock tube, with confirmed compatibility for 7.4V and 11.1V LiPo batteries. The replica is equipped with a T-Dean connector.

The SA-FH06 features a full-length Picatinny rail on top of the receiver, complemented by a set of four Picatinny rails on the handguard, providing a comprehensive mounting surface for scopes, tactical lights, vertical grips, or any other compatible accessories. The 6-position telescoping stock features a rubber buttpad for a stable rest. The outer barrel is threaded 14 mm counterclockwise (CCW), allowing for the direct attachment of a compatible suppressor or tracer. With its adjustable length, programmable versatility, and mechanics ready for upgrades, the SA-FH06 FLEX Gen.2 serves as a cohesive M4 platform for players looking to advance their skills without changing their replica.

DESCRIPTION
THE TOKYO MARUI EVOLT MK4 RECOIL SHOCK FPR AEG REPLICA: REALISTIC HANDLING AND RECOIL FEEL
The Tokyo Marui AEG EVOLT MK4 Recoil Shock FPR replica is an EBBR (Electric BlowBack Rifle) based on the AR-15/M4 platform, designed for experienced airsoft players seeking a shooting experience that closely mimics the handling of a real M4. The name FPR, short for Federal Patrol Rifle, refers here to a law enforcement-oriented configuration, recognizable by its M-LOK handguard with an integrated Picatinny rail and its length-adjustable crane stock. With its die-cast aluminum upper and lower receivers finished in black Cerakote and its external dimensions, this EVOLT MK4 embodies the Tokyo Marui approach: precision manufacturing, dimensional consistency with actual mil-spec parts, and in-house developed electronic technology.
An Enhanced Recoil Shock System
The Recoil Shock system in this EVOLT MK4 relies on a 300 g weight moving within the stock tube, guided by a POM rail. This mechanism produces a strong EBBR recoil with every shot, described by Tokyo Marui as the most powerful recoil ever incorporated into one of their AEGs. The effect is felt in both semi-automatic and full-automatic modes, which enhances the sensory consistency between the act of firing and the replica's physical response. This level of feedback is particularly appreciated during training or in demanding milsim scenarios.

The internal mechanism is based on a split gearbox divided into two distinct parts, the cylinder assembly and the gearbox itself, which allows for a realistic separation of the upper and lower receivers, just like on a real M4. This design facilitates access to internal components and meets the disassembly standards expected by users accustomed to handling a real M4. The EG1000BR motor features high-precision MinebeaMitsumi bearings, MIM gears, and 4 mm shafts on the spur and sector gears. The small-diameter cylinder is treated with a fluorinated lubricant.
The M-SYSTEM Type II: Advanced Electronics and Full Cycle Simulation
The EVOLT MK4 RS FPR incorporates the M-SYSTEM Type II, an MCU developed by Tokyo Marui and originally derived from the MP5 Next Generation platform, which has been adapted here for the M4 platform. This system manages firing modes (safe, semi-auto, full auto), processes data from internal sensors, and provides protection against operational malfunctions. An integrated MOSFET protects the electrical contacts and optimizes response during firing.

The end-of-magazine fire stop system is one of the most refined features of this replica. The first BB is loaded via the cocking lever, just like on a real M4. When the magazine is empty, the Auto Stop system automatically locks the mock bolt and prevents firing until a new magazine is reinserted. If the magazine is removed while it still contains BBs, the replica simulates the presence of a BB in the chamber without ejecting any. The Stabilizer Nozzle ensures proper nozzle alignment for consistent firing performance throughout sequences. These combined mechanisms accurately replicate the handling actions expected on a real AR platform.
Ergonomics, Compatibility, and Connectivity
The replica measures between 724 mm and 806 mm depending on the stock adjustment, and weighs 3,100 g. The fire selector is ambidextrous, meeting the needs of both left- and right-handed shooters. The M-LOK handguard with integrated top, bottom, and side Picatinny rails accommodates standard tactical accessories without the need for an additional adapter. The Crane stock offers length adjustment as well as an ergonomic cheek rest.

The receivers meet mil-spec dimensions, making them compatible with standard-sized real-world grips and stocks. The barrel thread is 14 mm counterclockwise (CCW), a common standard on airsoft replicas for attaching suppressors or tracer rounds. The battery connector is a Tokyo Marui proprietary design. To use a LiPo battery from another brand, a T-Dean adapter is required and sold separately. The included magazine is a dedicated Tokyo Marui EVOLT / EVOLT RS M4 model with a 81-bbs capacity; its stamped-steel-style body incorporates the Inner Elevation system and the One-by-One Loading System.

THE AEG E-416 CQB EVOLUTION AIRSOFT REPLICA, A COMPACT, REINFORCED PLATFORM FOR BEGINNERS IN CQB.
The AEG E-416 CQB EVOLUTION AIRSOFT replica is a long electric replica in a compact format, designed for beginner players looking for an E-416 / HK416 base suitable for close-quarters environments. Its appeal lies in a hybrid construction combining a Technopolymer Carbontech body, a CNC-machined aluminum Picatinny rail and reinforced internal mechanics. With an adjustable length from 700 to 785 mm and a weight of 2845 g, it offers a handy format while maintaining a solid presence in the hand.
Hybrid design for strength and handling
The Technopolymer Carbontech body offers a lighter structure than an all-metal body, while retaining good rigidity for regular airsoft use. This design is complemented by a CNC-machined, Picatinny-compatible aluminum rail system, enabling the installation of CQB accessories such as lights, grips and sighting aids.
The one-piece, CNC-machined outer barrel reinforces the impression of seriousness in the design of this E-416 CQB. This choice of construction limits superfluous front-end assemblies and contributes to the replica's overall stability. The 14 mm counter-clockwise threading also allows the addition of a compatible silencer or plotter, a particularly useful feature for indoor use.
Reinforced AEG mechanics for a reliable base
This Evolution Airsoft replica uses AEG technology and incorporates several internal components designed for durability. The reinforced gearbox, reinforced piston, 8 mm bearings and steel gear set form a coherent mechanical base for a player wishing to start out with an already well-equipped replica. The CNC-milled steel cylinder completes the internal assembly.
The High Torque 22,000 RPM motor provides a suitable response to a CQB configuration, where responsiveness is often more important than pure range. High Flow cabling accompanies this electrical architecture, while Tamiya's Mini connectors enable the use of a suitable battery. The recommended battery is a LiPo 7.4 V stick, not supplied with the replica.
Practical details for maintenance and use
The E-416 CQB EVOLUTION AIRSOFT features a rotating hop-up chamber, appreciated for its progressive and accessible adjustment. The functional bolt catch facilitates access to the hop-up adjustment and makes handling more intuitive. Body pins with retention system limit the risk of loss during disassembly, a useful detail for maintenance or simple interventions.
The quick-release spring guide allows access to the spring without removing the gearbox from the body, simplifying technical operations. The tool-free motor handle also facilitates work on this area of the replica. These choices make the platform easier to follow over time, especially for players who wish to gradually understand their replica without starting from an overly complex base.
A ready-to-play configuration, excluding power supply
The box contains the replica and a 140-round Mid-Cap Matrixx™ magazine. This type of charger favors a more realistic feed than a high-capacity charger and avoids the use of a thumbwheel. The battery and battery charger are not included, so you can choose a suitable feed right from the outset.
This black version adopts a CQB format relevant for building parties, dense areas or players who prefer a shorter replica to a long assault rifle. The absence of blowback keeps the AEG configuration simple, with the mechanics focused on efficiency of use and routine maintenance.
Conclusion
The AEG E-416 CQB EVOLUTION AIRSOFT replica is aimed at players who want to start out with a compact, well-equipped replica designed for CQB. Its Technopolymer Carbontech body, CNC-machined aluminum Picatinny rail, one-piece outer barrel, reinforced gearbox and High Torque 22,000 RPM motor make it a coherent basis for getting into airsoft with a serious platform. It will be particularly well-suited to users looking for an HK416-type replica that's easy to handle, practical to maintain and compatible with a modern accessory configuration.

THE AEG MP5 EYETRACE HK UMAREX, A COMPACT ELECTRIC REPLICA WITH INTEGRATED TRACER
The AEG MP5 Eyetrace HK Umarex replica is an AEG SMG-type electric airsoft replica, designed for players looking for a compact platform for dynamic gaming and use in dark environments. This device illuminates the pellets, making it easier to read their trajectory, immediately correct the shot and improve reactivity in intense situations. This design also keeps the front of the replica coherent, while allowing the barrel end to be accessorized with a silencer or flame arrestor via the 14 mm CCW thread at the end of the barrel. This sporty S-AEG version is not limited to its on-board tracer. It features an ECU gearbox with diagnostic function, an interesting point of difference for an electric platform intended for regular use. It also features an adjustable Hop-Up and an M-LOK handguard with front handle.
With this AEG MP5 Eyetrace HK replica, Umarex offers an electric MP5 base with modern features, designed for players who want to immediately exploit the potential of tracer beads right out of the box.

Name: AEG M249K Replica A&K AIRSOFT
Description:
DESCRIPTION
THE A&K AIRSOFT M249K AEG REPLICA, A COMPACT, LIGHTWEIGHT LMG
The A&K AIRSOFT AEG M249K replica is a compact, electric-powered light machine gun designed for airsoft players who want to take on a support role on the field. Weighing 3565 g and with a length ranging from 675 mm to 805 mm depending on the position of the retractable stock, it offers a compact footprint for a replica in this category. The polymer-based construction directly contributes to its lightweight design, without sacrificing key structural components, which remain made of metal.
Construction and Materials: A Carefully Considered Balance Between Lightweight and Durability
The body, bolt, handguard, stock, and pistol grip are made of polymer, which significantly reduces the overall weight compared to all-metal versions. At the same time, the parts subject to the most direct mechanical stress retain a metal finish: the trigger guard, trigger, safety, magazine, and muzzle brake are all made of metal, as is the outer barrel. The latter features a quick-detach (QD) system, allowing it to be removed without tools. It features a 14 mm counterclockwise (CCW) thread for attaching a suppressor or other compatible muzzle accessory. The handguard combines metal and polymer for a secure grip.
Features and Integrated Equipment
The replica operates in full-auto mode only, with a dedicated safety. The hop-up is adjustable, allowing you to fine-tune the spin applied to the BB to adapt range and accuracy to the terrain and playing conditions. The rear sight is also adjustable, and an integrated front sight provides direct aiming without the need for additional accessories. The retractable stock is length-adjustable to accommodate different body types or protective gear. The magazine well is positioned on the left side, in line with the real-world configuration of the M249, and is ready to accommodate the included M4-format 120-BB mid-cap magazine. The 7.4V LiPo battery with a T-Dean connector is housed in the handguard.
Picatinny Rails and Bipod-Grip: Tactical Versatility
The A&K AIRSOFT M249K AEG replica is equipped with four Picatinny rails: a top rail on the top of the replica, a bottom rail, and two side rails on the handguard. This configuration allows you to mount a scope, a tactical flashlight, or any other Picatinny-compatible accessory according to the player's needs. The included bipod is extendable and attaches to the lower Picatinny rail. Its design also allows it to function as a front tactical grip, making it a particularly useful 2-in-1 accessory for quickly adapting the replica to a prone position or for moving while standing.

Description:
DESCRIPTION
THE FN SCAR-L AEG FROM CYMA, AN OFFICIALLY LICENSED FN HERSTAL REPLICA WITH A FULLY AMBIDEXTROUS CHARACTER
CYMA's FN Herstal Licensed SCAR-L AEG is an electric airsoft assault rifle that faithfully reproduces one of the world's most recognized military platforms, under official FN Herstal license. It is designed for intermediate players looking to upgrade to a premium replica, as well as for advanced players looking for a solid, directly upgradeable base. The combination of a metal top receiver and laser-engraved markings gives this replica a clear positioning above the entry-level range, without imposing a competition budget.
Construction and materials: metal where it counts, high-strength polymer for weight reduction
The upper receiver, outer barrel and rails are made of metal, ensuring structural rigidity and durability in use. The lower receiver and stock, on the other hand, are made of high-strength polymer, a choice that significantly lightens the overall weight without compromising the strength of the assembly. The upper Picatinny rail is monolithic and one-piece, ensuring perfect continuity along the entire length of the replica and greater stability for forward-mounted optics and accessories. Picatinny rails are also present on the underside and sides, allowing the addition of grips, tactical lights or other compatible accessories. FN Herstal markings are laser-engraved directly onto the receiver, reflecting an official license rather than simple printing.
AEG technology and interior: V2 gearbox, adjustable hop-up and 275 mm barrel
The replica is powered by a Version 2 gearbox, and the long-axis motor drives the entire mechanical assembly. The hop-up system is adjustable, allowing the rotation effect applied to the balls to be corrected to adapt the range to playing conditions and the weight of the ammunition used. The internal barrel measures 275 mm, a length that represents a good compromise between precision at medium range and maneuverability in confined spaces. The external barrel thread is 14 mm counter-clockwise (CCW), compatible with the majority of silencers, tracers and adapters available on the airsoft market. Power is supplied by a 7.4 V LiPo battery with T-Dean connector, a format that can be used directly without adapters by users already equipped with T-Dean.
Ergonomics and versatility in the field: full ambidextry and six-position grip
CYMA's SCAR-L is distinguished by its fully ambidextrous design, designed for unrestricted use regardless of the shooter's laterality. The firing selector, magazine ejection button and cocking lever are all reversible or accessible from either side. Three firing modes are available: safety, semi-automatic and full-automatic. The stock offers six length-adjustment positions and folds sideways, making the replica particularly suitable for fast travel, CQB configurations or transport. The cheek rest is height-adjustable to adapt the weapon to the shooter's morphology or to the use of raised optics. Flip-up sights can be folded down to release the top rail without disassembly. Compatibility with standard AEG M4 / M16 magazines opens up a wide range of supply options, in both mid-cap and hi-cap versions.

Name: Scorpion Evo 3 A1 B.E.T FDE ASG
Description:
DESCRIPTION
The CZ Scorpion Evo 3 A1 is a submachine gun produced by Ceska Zbrojovka Uhersky for the police forces of the Czech Republic. Very light and compact, its advantage is that it can deliver high firepower at short range in confined areas.
Produced by ASG, this replica has been completely manufactured by the brand and comes straight from the factory based in Denmark!
Here in a B.E.T FDE version with an integrated silencer, the Scorpion is highly reliable and robust thanks to its Gearbox and high-torque reinforced metal Gears.
Its adjustable Hop-up system and 6.05mm precision barrel will give you accurate shots.
Like the original weapon, the replica will not fire if the magazine is empty. For even more realism, you'll also need to engage the functional bolt catch after changing the magazine.
You'll be able to easily add more features to your replica.
You'll be able to easily add your various sights and other tactical accessories via the top Picatinny rail, the two side rails and the one under the barrel.
The folding and retractable stock will allow you to adapt to any game situation, as well as making it easier to carry.
The CZ Scorpion EVO.3 B.E.T comes with a 75-round low-cap polymer magazine.
The manufacturer recommends using 11.1v Lipo to avoid damaging the built-in Mosfet.

Description:
DESCRIPTION
THE AEG SR25 CM.098A PLATINUM CYMA REPLICA, A DMR PLATFORM BUILT FOR LONG-RANGE PRECISION
The AEG SR25 CM.098A Platinum replica from CYMA is aimed at airsoft players looking for a reliable DMR platform with an electric motor and a finish worthy of the brand's Platinum range. Based on the architecture of the SR25 / AR10, this replica features a long, imposing profile, designed for long-range engagement. It incorporates internal components of superior quality to those usually found in this price range, making it a relevant choice both for immediate use in the field and as a serious basis for a gradual move upmarket.
Built for durability and precision
The replica body, receivers, handguard, outer barrel, stock tube, selector and trigger are made of aluminum. This choice of material ensures appreciable structural rigidity while maintaining good balance for a replica of this size. The pistol grip, stock and piston are made of polymer. The handguard is equipped with M-LOK slots, enabling common tactical accessories to be fitted without additional adapters.
The external barrel is threaded in 14 mm counterclockwise / CCW muzzle exit, a widely used standard that opens compatibility to a wide range of muzzle accessories. The stock is adjustable to 6 positions, making it easy to adapt to different body shapes or to carry with protection. Foldable sights are fitted as standard, providing an easy-to-use and effective mechanical opponent acquisition system. The firing selector and sling mounting plate are both ambidextrous, a functional detail appreciated by left- and right-handed shooters alike.
A long V2 gearbox with Platinum CNC internals
The central technical feature of this replica is its long V2 gearbox. Compared to a standard M4 V2 gearbox, the longer cylinder offers greater air volume, directly beneficial for DMR use with long internal barrels. This extra volume improves the consistency of ball-to-ball propulsion, which is precisely what we're looking for in this type of configuration.
The gears are CNC machined in steel, the cylinder and cylinder head are also CNC aluminum, and the piston has steel teeth. All in all, a gearbox that can be described as homogeneous in its materials, with no obvious weak points due to undersized parts. The High Torque motor fitted as standard is adapted to the strength of a spring calibrated for DMR use, and guarantees correct firing responsiveness in semi-automatic mode.
The integrated MOSFET protects the control electronics from arcing due to trigger contact, extending the service life of the whole unit. It is compatible with 7.4V or 11.1V Li-Po batteries on a T-Dean connector, a high-performance connector format found on most high-performance batteries on the market.
6.03 mm precision barrel and DMR-oriented hop-up system
The internal barrel has a 6.03 mm bore, tighter than the standard 6.08 mm. This reduced tolerance ensures precise ball guidance along the entire internal path, consistent with long-range shooting. The hop-up system is adjustable and based on a conventional V2 M4 block, making it easy to replace or upgrade with standard market hop-up joints and hop-up arms.
To fully exploit this potential, the use of 0.28 g or 0.30 g bbs is recommended. These weights help maintain a stable trajectory at distance, taking advantage of the ball's mass to resist aerodynamic drift, particularly useful for outdoor engagements on open terrain. The quick-change spring system, accessible from the rear of the gearbox, makes it possible to adapt the spring without completely dismantling the replica, a concrete advantage for players who modify their configuration according to the FPS rules specific to each terrain.

THE GBB COMBAT MASTER BALLERINA EMG X TTI ARMY ARMAMENT LICENSED REPLICA: A COLLECTOR'S ITEM DESIGNED FOR THE FIELD
The GBB Combat Master BALLERINA EMG x TTI Licensed Replica, produced by ARMY ARMAMENT, is a Gas Blowback airsoft pistol that faithfully reproduces the aesthetics of TTI's most recognizable builds. Offered under an official Taran Tactical Innovations license in collaboration with EMG, it is aimed at both GBB airsoft players and collectors seeking licensed editions. The dual-finish bronze finish, combining a matte metallic look with a high-gloss coyote bronze oxidation, makes it a visually distinctive piece in the world of high-end replica pistols.
Construction: CNC-machined aluminum, steel, and polymer for precision
The slide is CNC-machined from aluminum and features the same bronze finish as the compensator, magwell, and magazine baseplate, all of which are also CNC-machined. This combination gives the replica a completely cohesive visual appearance, enhanced by the TTI markings engraved on both sides of the slide, on its top, on the compensator, and on the magazine well. The frame is made of matte black polymer, while the slide catch and hammer are made of steel to withstand mechanical stress. The barrel is also CNC-machined. The balance between lightness and durability is thus carefully distributed according to the role of each component.
Ergonomics Designed for Comfort and Customization
The polymer grip features hand-stippled texturing, a handcrafted finish that improves grip in all conditions. Additional grip areas are integrated under the trigger guard and under the slide, designed for two-handed control using the left and right index fingers. The flat trigger is adjustable, allowing the trigger pull to be tailored to the shooter's preferences. The slide stop is ambidextrous and incorporates a replaceable slide saver, a useful technical feature that extends the part's lifespan by limiting wear during firing cycles. The green fiber-optic front sight completes the ergonomics, designed for precision and comfort of use.
Compatibility and Field Versatility
The receiver features a low-profile RMR cutout, allowing for the mounting of a compact RMR red dot sight. A CNC-machined aluminum scope cover is included to enable co-witnessing with the standard rear sight and front sight provided, allowing the replica to be used with or without a scope without compromising accuracy. The compensator features an 11 mm CW thread, compatible with suitable threaded accessories. A 4-slot Picatinny rail is located under the barrel to accommodate a tactical flashlight or any other compatible accessory. The replica comes with a 28-bbs gas magazine featuring an extended magazine base with an EMG x TTI bronze finish.

The M1A1 Paratrooper is associated with the American airborne troops of the Second World War, who were looking for a more compact model that would be easier to carry during jumps and rapid movements. Its folding metal stock gave it an instantly recognizable silhouette and made it easy to carry in confined spaces, as well as during jumps to avoid getting hit in the jaw when landing. This configuration has made it one of the most iconic variants for reenactment and historical replica enthusiasts.

The SALVO PRECISION GBBR SCX Rattler .300 5.5" MWS-style replica is a compact gas blowback rifle (GBBR) designed in the spirit of the SIG MCX Rattler. It is aimed at CQB and milsim players looking for a high-performance PDW platform based on Tokyo Marui's Gen 2 MWS ZET standard. Measuring 390 mm when folded and 600 mm with the stock extended, it offers true compactness for engagements in confined spaces, without compromising on build durability.
Construction: CNC-machined aluminum, stainless steel, and Gen 2 modifications
The SCX Rattler's body is CNC-machined from aluminum, while the internal components are made of reinforced steel. The bolt, the central component of the firing cycle, is made of stainless steel, which enhances both durability and recoil feel compared to a standard bolt. The minimalist folding stock is also made of stainless steel, complemented by a rubber buttpad to absorb shocks and improve comfort when shouldering the rifle.

The Gen 2 version incorporates three improvements directly based on feedback from the Gen 1: a recoil spring buffer integrated into the lower receiver for better absorption of the bolt's travel, a revision of the barrel mounting system to eliminate play and improve accuracy, and a redesign of the hop-up chamber base for a more stable assembly. These improvements make this version a significantly more refined product than its predecessor.
GBB Technology: Short-stroke piston system based on the MWS ZET platform
The SCX Rattler operates on Tokyo Marui's MWS ZET platform, a short-stroke piston GBB system renowned for its smooth and rapid cycle. It features both semi-automatic and automatic firing modes. The short-stroke bolt system incorporates a guide rail with springs and rollers, ensuring a fast and consistent cycle.

The hop-up chamber is adjustable and provides tactile feedback during adjustments. Its design, integrated directly into the base of the outer barrel, minimizes play between the hop-up seal and the inner barrel, two components that are often the source of inaccuracies on GBBR platforms. The outer barrel has a 14 mm counterclockwise (14 mm CCW) thread, compatible with most suppressors.
Ergonomics and Interfaces: Ambidextrous Controls, M-LOK and Picatinny Mounts
The SCX Rattler features a partially ambidextrous control system: the fire selector, cocking handle, and magazine release are accessible with either hand. The bolt catch, however, is operable only from the left side. The magazine well is flared to facilitate rapid reloads, particularly in CQB situations.

The 5.5-inch Gen 2 M-LOK handguard and the Picatinny rail on top allow for mounting optics, flashlights, grips, and other accessories depending on the desired configuration. Ambidextrous QD mounts are located on the handguard, the rear of the receiver, and the stock, offering multiple sling attachment options. The folding stock is height-adjustable and can fold to either the left or right, depending on the player's preference.

In terms of compatibility, the replica accepts AR15/M4 gas magazines from SALVO PRECISION, Double Eagle, and Tokyo Marui MWS, as well as most parts that meet Tokyo Marui's MWS GBBR standard.

Produced in limited quantities, this replica promises to be in the field as soon as it's released.

DESCRIPTION
La firme Japonaise Tokyo Marui est spécialisée dans la fabrication de réplique d'arme à air comprimé. La qualité et les performances de ses produits lui ont permis de s'imposer comme un leader dans l'univers de l'Airsoft.

La marque nous propose une toute nouvelle réplique, le Scorpion Mod M. Elle est équipée d'une Gearbox AEG miniaturisée. Malgré sa taille, le Scorpion possède une excellente qualité de tir et une portée suffisante pour rivaliser avec les AEG Standards.

Cet AEP fonctionne avec les batteries 7.2V Micro 500 NIMH Tokyo Marui (vendues séparément) grâce à l'adaptateur EX fournie avec la réplique.

En externe, on retrouve un garde-main M-Lock. La réplique est fournie avec 3 rails Picatinny (3, 5 et 7 crans). On retrouve également une crosse type squelette qui fait également office de poignée tactique une fois pliée.

La réplique possède un look moderne avec une queue de détente droite, un canon externe et une culasse disposant d'une finition en Or anodisé. Le cache-flamme agressif et réversible s'adapte sur le pas de vis 14mm CCW.

Dans la boite, vous trouverez un chargeur long Hi-cap de 260 billes disposant de la même finition "quadrillage" que le Pistol grip, permettant une prise en main parfaite !

Name: ARO Dot Sight HOLOSUN
Description:
DESCRIPTION
A HIGH-QUALITY SIGHT INTEGRATING SHAKE AWAKE TECHNOLOGY
The ARO Dot Sight provides access to a single 2 MOA dot at its center. The reticle can be adjusted with 10 brightness levels for daylight use (DL or Day Light) and 2 brightness levels designed for nighttime use, compatible with night vision systems (NV or Night Vision). Reticle adjustment can be made in 0.5 MOA increments per click for elevation and windage, within a range of +/- 50 MOA.
The 7075 T5 aluminum construction provides a premium finish and allows resistance to shocks up to 1000G. Its multi-coated Titanium Grade 5 glass ensures high resistance and durability in extreme conditions such as marine environments. The IP67 certification guarantees protection against water and dust, in addition to resistance to operating temperatures ranging from -30°C to -60°C and storage temperatures from -40°C to -70°C.
This optic features Shake Awake technology, which automatically turns off the LED reticle after 10 minutes of inactivity (programmable up to 12 hours). It resumes in the last used mode when movement is detected again, thanks to an "ultra-sensitive" motion sensor.
The ARO Dot Sight comes with two Picatinny mounts, allowing you to position your optic at the height that suits you best. The first 1.63" 1/3 co-witness "high" mount is fully compatible with an HM3X Magnifier, while the second 1.05" mount is considered "low". The sight is available in two distinct models: Green Dot or Red Dot.

Name: Lite Automatic 1100 bbs Speedloader T238
Description:
DESCRIPTION
THE T238 LITE 1100-BB AUTOMATIC SPEEDLOADER, A MULTI-SYSTEM ELECTRIC LOADER DESIGNED FOR EFFICIENCY ON THE FIELD
The T238 Lite 1100-BB Automatic Speedloader is a motorized electric loader capable of feeding 6mm BBs into a wide range of airsoft loaders, including AEGs, GBBs, spring-powered bolt-action models, and gas cartridges for pump-action rifles. It's designed for regular players who want to reduce reload time between rounds, whether during team training, CQB, or simulation scenarios. Its compact size, precise counting features, and native multi-system compatibility make it a practical tool, engineered for demanding field use.
A design built for durability and compactness
The Speedloader Lite's body is made of PC/ABS, a material that combines rigidity and lightness for a total weight of 460 grams with the built-in battery. Its dimensions of 185 x 75 x 52 mm allow it to fit into a magazine pouch or radio pouch (see recommended products).
The central component of the feeding mechanism, the BB drive wheel, is made of 304 stainless steel. This material choice ensures high mechanical strength to withstand repeated loading cycles, whereas a polymer wheel would wear out more quickly under intensive use. The motor operates via a direct-drive system with gear reduction, delivering a torque of 17 kg·cm and a maximum thrust of 55 N, sufficient to feed heavy-duty spring-loaded magazines without excessive force.
Smart features for precise loading control
The Speedloader Lite's interface features an OLED screen and a 4-way directional pad with a center button, allowing you to navigate settings and view real-time battery voltage, the number of BBs loaded, and the current loading speed. The device achieves a maximum rate of 16 BBs per second at 12.6 V, which significantly reduces the time required to fill a high-capacity magazine.
Two operating modes are available. Preset mode allows you to set a fixed quantity of 1 to 999 BBs, with automatic shutdown once the target is reached. Five independent PRESET slots can be configured separately, a useful option for players who use multiple types of magazines with different capacities. An OFFSET slot also allows you to compensate for BBs lost at the adapter, with an adjustment range of 0 to 5 BBs. Dynamic manual mode triggers loading upon contact and stops when the trigger is released, providing total control without a preset value.
Jam management is fully automated: in the event of a jam, the motor shuts off in less than 0.01 seconds, and the system then attempts to clear the jam by reversing the motor over three successive cycles, without requiring any manual intervention. If the jam persists, an audible alert accompanies a "GEAR STALL" notification on the OLED screen. An empty-tank alert completes this system, signaled by a buzzer and on-screen display.
Multi-system compatibility and built-in power supply
The Speedloader Lite comes with four polymer adapter tips covering the main systems encountered in the field. Adapter A is compatible with AK- and AR-type AEG magazines and most standard formats, including the PTS EPM1 250-bbs magazine. Adapter B is designed for GBBR pump-action rifle magazines. Adapter C is suitable for spring-powered bolt-action magazines, and Adapter D supports GBB magazines from WE, GHK, MWS, and Tokyo Marui. Use is strictly limited to 6 mm plastic BBs: BBs of any other diameter and metal ammunition are incompatible and may damage internal components.
Power is supplied via a 2S or 3S LiPo battery with a T-shaped connector, with a maximum supported size of 102 × 19 × 16 mm. The Speedloader automatically detects the number of cells and adjusts its operation accordingly. Electronic protections round out the device: low- and high-voltage cut-off, thermal protection for the integrated ESC above 85°C with automatic power reduction, and a configurable standby mode that activates after 30, 60, 90, or 120 minutes of inactivity. Maximum power consumption is 40 W.
It is essential never to reverse the battery polarity and never to exceed 13 V: these errors cause irreversible damage to the motherboard. The operating temperature range is from -20 °C to +45 °C, covering all conditions encountered during outdoor gaming in both winter and summer.

Name: Satellite 1300-bbs Automatic Speedloader LAYLAX
Description:
DESCRIPTION
THE LAYLAX SATELLITE 1300-BBS AUTOMATIC SPEEDLOADER: A RELIABLE AND VERSATILE MOTORIZED RELOADING SOLUTION
The LAYLAX Satellite Automatic Speedloader is a motorized BB loader designed to fully automate the refilling of airsoft magazines. It's ideal for players who want to save time between matches, reduce manual handling, and protect their BBs during loading. With a storage capacity of approximately 1300 BBs and an automatic shut-off system, it's a convenient preparation tool for use both on the field and at home.
Motorized operation designed for efficiency
The Satellite is powered by an electric motor running on 4 AAA alkaline batteries. Simply insert the adapter that matches the magazine you're using, and the loading process starts automatically. Once the magazine is full, the speedloader stops on its own, preventing BBs from spilling over. This fully automatic cycle prevents BB loss and unnecessary interruptions: you can continuously fill approximately 8 AEG mid-cap magazines (150 BBs each) with a single full charge.
BB protection ensured by the POM gear
The feed gear is made of polyoxymethylene (POM) resin, a self-lubricating material known for its mechanical properties. This design choice reduces friction as the BBs pass through, thereby limiting the risk of deformation or microcracks during loading. The smooth operation of the feed mechanism helps preserve the integrity of the bbs.
Maximum versatility thanks to the 4 included adapters
The Satellite comes with a set of 4 adapters covering the main types of airsoft magazines: standard AEG magazines, MWS magazines, GBB pistol magazines, and bolt-action sniper replica magazines. Each adapter attaches to the speedloader's outlet to ensure a snug fit with the type of magazine being used, without requiring any additional tools.
The Laylax Satellite Speedloader: Safe Transport Guaranteed
The sliding top cover of this speedloader features a safety mode: when closed, it locks the motor's trigger mechanism and prevents any accidental discharge of BBs during transport or storage. Measuring 120 x 110 x 75 mm and weighing 490 g, the Satellite remains a compact and easily transportable piece of equipment.

Its interface combines a 4-way button + OK button and an OLED display, enabling simple adjustment and clear monitoring of live information (voltage, number of balls loaded, speed).

We also feature an advanced protection logic with voltage control, overheating protection (power reduction as soon as température exceeds 85°C) and automatic standby after a programmable period of inactivity of 30/60/90/120 min. THE ORIGINS OF THE REAL M79
The M79, also known as the "Thumper", is a 40 mm-caliber grenade launcher originally used by the US Army in the 1960s. Its name "Thumper" or "Blooper" is due to the characteristic noise it makes when fired. This grenade launcher was designed to increase infantry firepower by providing this solution, the M79. In fact, it's a good alternative: more precision, greater range than a rifle grenade, yet much more compact than a mortar.
THE SAWED-OFF M79: A VERSION CREATED IN THE FIELD
The sawed-off version of the M79 was not a genuine U.S. Army creation. It was in fact a modification of the M79 that was widespread during the Vietnam War, created directly by soldiers with the tools they had at their disposal (saw,...), for several reasons:
Very useful for close combat: by sawing off the barrel and part of the stock of the original M79 grenade launcher, soldiers created a smaller, more manageable and practical alternative for drawing it as quickly as possible.
Firing non-explosive ammunition at close range: soldiers could more easily fire buckshot, beehive, tear-gas and smoke grenades at close range, particularly useful for ambushes, fighting in tight spaces, etc...
A lighter load for the grenadier: he usually carried the M79 in addition to a pistol or carbine, making the whole thing heavy and cumbersome. The sawed-off version of the M79 was therefore a good solution, as it was easier to carry while lightening the overall load.
The M79 sawed-off grenade launcher, a true field creation, lives on in this highly realistic, authentic King Arms replica.

Name: 6.7" QD suppressor with Acetech Blaster M tracer and flash hider ANGRY GUN
Description:
DESCRIPTION
THE 6.7" QD SUPPRESSOR WITH ACETECH BLASTER M TRACER AND ANGRY GUN FLASH HIDER--A COMPLETE TACTICAL ACCESSORY
The 6.7" ANGRY GUN is an airsoft accessory that combines a dummy suppressor body made of 6061 aluminum, an integrated Acetech Blaster M tracer module, and a flash hider, all mounted via a Quick Detach system on a 14 mm counterclockwise (CCW) thread. It is designed for airsoft players who want to add a tracer effect and a visual flame simulation to their replica, all in a single accessory. Its 14 mm CCW compatibility makes it compatible with the vast majority of airsoft replicas on the market equipped with this thread.
Construction and Materials: An All-Metal Assembly
The suppressor body is machined from 6061 aluminum, an alloy known for its optimal balance between light weight and resistance to repeated mechanical stress. The internal parts are made of steel, which enhances the unit's durability at the points of greatest stress. The included flash hider features a QPQ coating, a surface treatment that improves resistance to corrosion and wear while providing a sleek finish. The suppressor features comprehensive Full RC3-style markings, inspired by the Surefire SOCOM556, which contribute to the unit's visual realism. With an external diameter of 39 mm, a total length of 170 mm, and a weight of 405 g, it offers a silhouette consistent with accessories of this type used on M4/AR-15 airsoft replicas.
Integrated Acetech Blaster M tracer module: the key technical feature
The main advantage of this suppressor lies in the direct integration of the Acetech Blaster M tracer module inside the body, without requiring an adapter or intermediate part. This module activates the release of green tracer BBs as they exit the replica and simultaneously generates a simulated flash visible at the muzzle. The lithium-ion battery is built into the suppressor and recharges via a USB cable. The QD (Quick Detach) system allows for quick attachment and removal of the suppressor without tools, which is useful in the field when the replica's configuration needs to be changed rapidly.
Field Use and Compatibility
This suppressor can be mounted on any airsoft replica with a 14 mm CCW barrel thread--the most common configuration on AEG or GBBR-type replicas such as the M4, M16, HK416, and derivative platforms. The tracer effect works with green tracer BBs compatible with the Acetech Blaster M module. During night games or in low-light environments, the combination of tracer BBs and flame simulation provides immediate visual realism. The QPQ coating on the flash hider and the aluminum/steel construction ensure optimal long-term durability, even during intensive field use. This suppressor is available in Black and FDE to perfectly match a variety of setups.

Description:
DESCRIPTION
THE MARTINA TACTICAL SMOKEY WOLF RGB TRACER SUPPRESSOR: FOUR FUNCTIONS COMBINED IN A SINGLE COMPACT ACCESSORY
The Smokey Wolf RGB Tracer suppressor from MARTINA TACTICAL is a multifunctional accessory designed for airsoft players who want to enhance their gaming experience without adding more accessories. In a single 120 mm unit, it combines a three-mode smoke effect, a programmable tracer, adjustable Firelight RGB lighting, and a built-in chronograph. It’s ideal for both experienced players looking to optimize their setup and enthusiasts drawn to an immersive visual experience on the field.
Durable Construction and Compact Design
The Smokey Wolf’s body is made of high-quality aluminum alloy with a matte black finish. This material choice offers optimal durability while keeping the weight to a manageable 110 g, minimizing the impact on the replica’s balance during extended play. Its 120 mm length offers a compact design suitable for both short setups and standard configurations. The built-in 600 mAh battery is rechargeable via a USB-C port and features a two-color indicator light to show the charge status: red while charging, green when the battery is fully charged.
Four functions in a single accessory
The smoke system produces a visual cloud in three adjustable modes, powered by the dedicated fluid included. The programmable tracer illuminates the green tracer BBs as they exit the barrel for a distinctive visual effect in low-light conditions. The Firelight RGB lighting allows you to adjust the color and brightness according to the player’s preferences. The built-in chronograph directly measures the replica’s velocity without requiring an external device. All of these functions can be controlled via the module and through the Martina Connect app, available on iOS and Android, via Bluetooth connection. A smart power-saving system automatically shuts down the accessory when it is not in use to preserve battery life.
Compatibility and Field Use
The Smokey Wolf is compatible with replicas featuring a 14 mm counterclockwise (CCW) thread, which accounts for the vast majority of airsoft replicas. A 14 mm CCW to 11 mm clockwise (CW) adapter is included, expanding compatibility to replicas equipped with this thread. The accessory operates within a temperature range of -10 °C to +45 °C, covering typical outdoor and indoor playing conditions. The USB-A to USB-C charging cable and two vials of smoke fluid are included with the accessory, allowing for immediate use upon receipt.

THE SMOKEY WOLF EVOLUTION TRACER SILENCER BY MARTINA TACTICAL, A MULTIFUNCTIONAL AIRSOFT ACCESSORY
The Smokey Wolf EVOLUTION Tracer Silencer by MARTINA TACTICAL is an airsoft accessory that combines four distinct functions into a single unit: smoke generation, programmable tracer mode, firelight, and a built-in chronograph. A three-mode smoke system controlled by Mag Pods

Three intensity levels are available, activated via Mag Pods—the consumables designed specifically for the Split Tank format. This system allows you to adjust the visual effect according to the scenario’s requirements. The operating temperature range extends from -10 °C to +45 °C, covering the vast majority of conditions encountered in the field.
Programmable tracer, firelight, and chronograph: three built-in tools
Beyond smoke, the Smokey Wolf EVOLUTION features a tracer mode compatible with green tracer BBs—whose parameters are configurable—a firelight mode, and a built-in chronograph that allows you to measure BB velocity directly from the accessory. These three functions can be accessed and managed via the module itself and through the Martina Connect app, available on iOS and Android. The connection is established via Bluetooth, allowing you to adjust settings without physically handling the accessory. Smart power management optimizes the battery life of the internal battery, which is rechargeable via USB-C. The built-in two-color indicator light shows the charge status in real time: red while charging, green when the battery is full.
Compatibility and Installation
The Smokey Wolf EVOLUTION MARTINA TACTICAL Tracer Silencer mounts on replicas equipped with a 14 mm counterclockwise (CCW) thread, the most common standard in airsoft. Description:
DESCRIPTION
VIDEO PRESENTATION OF THE AURAMIST TRACER SILENCER FROM ACETECH
THE ACETECH AURAMIST TRACER SUPPRESSOR: AN IMMERSIVE, WATER-BASED VISUAL EXPERIENCE
The ACETECH AuraMist is an all-in-one tracer suppressor designed for airsoft players seeking a complete and realistic visual effect without the limitations of traditional oil-based systems. By combining a tracer function for glow-in-the-dark BBs, an LED flash that simulates a muzzle flame, and a water vaporization system to reproduce the smoke effect, the AuraMist offers up to seven mode combinations that can be activated depending on the desired effect. It is suitable for players in both outdoor and indoor games, as well as cosplay enthusiasts and demonstration organizers. Weighing approximately 65 g (module only) and featuring a universal 14 mm counterclockwise (CCW) thread, it can be easily mounted on the vast majority of AEG, GBB, or HPA replicas.
Clean, residue-free water vaporization technology
Whereas conventional tracers use mineral oil to generate the mist, the AuraMist uses only water. This approach offers a direct and tangible advantage: no oily residue is deposited in the inner barrel or the hop-up chamber, eliminating any risk of fouling caused by the tracer itself. The built-in 4.2 ml reservoir can be easily filled with tap water through a front-access inlet—without disassembly—using the supplied syringe bottles. For those who wish to intensify the mist effect and add a scent, the AuraMist can accommodate one to two drops of essential oil diluted in water; do not exceed this dosage to preserve the vaporizer. Once the session is complete, the automatic drying function flushes and dries the unit and the internal chamber, extending the component’s lifespan.
Seven combinable effect modes and intelligent power management
The AuraMist offers seven combinations of independent or combined effects: trace only, LED flash only, mist only, trace + flash, trace + mist, flash + mist, and the full combination of trace + flash + mist. Each mode is designed for a different use case, from nighttime events where the tracer function visually guides shots, to indoor demonstrations where the fog and flash create a cinematic effect. The unit is powered by a USB-C rechargeable Li-Ion battery, with a charging time of approximately 2.5 hours. To conserve power, a standby mode automatically activates after five minutes of inactivity. A built-in self-diagnostic system continuously monitors the status of the sensors and the unit’s proper functioning. The supported rate of fire reaches 35 shots per second, which easily accommodates even the most responsive AEG or HPA setups. The AuraMist is compatible with standard 6 mm BBs as well as 6 mm green and red tracer BBs.
A removable module compatible with other dummy silencers
One of the AuraMist’s distinctive features is its modular design. The internal module can be removed from its original housing and installed in a third-party dummy silencer with an inner diameter of 37.6 mm. For silencers with a slightly larger diameter, shimming is possible to ensure the module is centered. This modularity allows the AuraMist to be adapted to the replica’s aesthetics without sacrificing its functionality. In terms of connectivity, the native thread is 14 mm CCW.

VIDEO PRESENTATION OF THE MARTINA TACTICAL SMOKEY WOLF MINI2 TRACER SILENCER
THE MARTINA TACTICAL SMOKEY WOLF MINI2 TRACER SILENCER, A MULTIFUNCTIONAL BLUETOOTH-CONTROLLED ACCESSORY
The Smokey Wolf Mini2 Tracer Silencer by MARTINA TACTICAL is much more than just a silencer: it’s an integrated module combining a programmable tracer, chronograph, flash effects, and smoke system—all controllable via the silencer’s built-in module and from a smartphone. It is designed for airsoft players who want to enhance their on-field experience with realistic visual effects, while having access to precise adjustment tools in just a few seconds. Compact at 86 mm long and weighing 90 g, it represents the second generation of the Smokey Wolf Mini—a V2 version that introduces Bluetooth control, a built-in chronograph, and the MAG POD MINI Split Tank system.
A Compact Aluminum Construction
The body of the Smokey Wolf Mini2 is machined from aluminum alloy with a matte black finish, which provides good resistance to the mechanical stresses of the field while minimizing its impact on the replica’s balance. Weighing just 90 g and measuring 86 mm in length, it remains unobtrusive when mounted on the barrel, without adding excessive weight to the front of the replica. The built-in 600 mAh battery charges via a USB-C port, and an LED indicator shows the charge status in real time: red while charging, green when the battery is full. The module is designed to operate within a temperature range of -10°C to 45°C, making it suitable for use in a variety of weather conditions.
Advanced features controlled via the Martina Connect app
The Smokey Wolf Mini2 features a customizable smoke trail generator compatible with green tracer beads, a timer, and a strobe system—all accessible and configurable from the module and via the Martina Connect app, available on iOS (App Store) and Android (Google Play). The connection is made via Bluetooth. The smoke system offers three distinct modes, powered by the MAG POD MINI Split Tank, which comes with three pods included in the package. The flash and smoke effects can be turned on or off independently depending on the needs of the game or the rules of the field. A smart power management system extends battery life by limiting power consumption when the module is inactive.
Expanded compatibility thanks to the included adapter
The Smokey Wolf Mini2 mounts on replicas equipped with a 14 mm counterclockwise (CCW) thread, the most common standard in airsoft. A 11 mm clockwise (CW) to 14 mm counterclockwise (CCW) adapter is included right in the box, expanding compatibility to replicas that use this thread. The tracer is removable, allowing it to be used on multiple replicas as needed. This versatility, combined with its compact size and the full range of features integrated into a single module, makes the Smokey Wolf Mini2 a comprehensive option for players looking to combine visual effects and performance tracking in a single accessory.

Description:
DESCRIPTION
DANIEL DEFENSE RIS III 9.5" M-LOK EMG HANDGUARD FOR AEG CYMA, AN OFFICIALLY LICENSED PART FOR REALISTIC, MODULAR CUSTOMIZATION
This handguard is designed for airsoft enthusiasts who want to modernize the outward appearance of their M4 / AR AEG CYMA replica, based on a real-world market reference. Produced under official Daniel Defense license, it faithfully reproduces the RIS III model with its authenticated markings and engravings, giving it immediate visual credibility. It's ideal for gamers concerned with the realism of their equipment, as well as for users looking to extend the mounting capabilities of their replica.
Aluminium construction and matt finish: a CNC-machined block
The body of the handguard is made entirely of CNC-machined aluminum alloy, for dimensionally precise results and an even surface. Its length of 9.5 inches, or 247 mm, fits into an intermediate format suitable for a wide variety of compact to standard M4 replica configurations. Weighing in at 315 g, it lends a perceptible physical presence without excessively weighing down the overall replica. The finish is matte metallic, consistent with the aesthetics of reference military handguards.
M-LOK system and Picatinny rail: full-length modularity
The RIS III is based on a modern mounting philosophy. M-LOK slots distributed along the sides and bottom of the handguard allow accessories such as front grips, tactical lights or laser systems to be attached, occupying only the space required. The 20 mm Picatinny rail (1913 standard) runs the full length of the upper face, ensuring continuity of mounting with the replica rail for installing optics or red dot without breaking alignment. This M-LOK / Picatinny combination represents a direct evolution of the old RIS II systems, which were entirely covered by rails, offering a smaller footprint and a more ergonomic profile.
Compatibility and installation on AEG M4 / AR15 replicas
This handguard is designed specifically for AEG M4 / AR15 CYMA replicas. For all other platforms, manual adjustments may be necessary, and direct compatibility is not guaranteed. It is available in three distinct finishes: black, Flat Dark Earth and grey, enabling the entire build to be matched to the desired livery. The official Daniel Defense markings, integrated under license, are engraved on the body of the handguard and identically reproduce those found on versions intended for the real market.

Safe - Semi - Auto

Safe - Burst 3 beads - Auto
Safe - Semi - Semi

Disconnect the battery from your AEG replica.
Select your battery type on the case (NiMh / LiPo).
Connect your replica's connector to the case on one side and your battery on the other.
Select the desired mode using the switch on the case.
Press the "Enter" button to confirm your selection, and you'll hear a long beep when the operation is complete.
Unplug the case and reconnect your battery to the replica.

Name: DJI Osmo Nano Standard Combo action camera
Description:
DESCRIPTION
DJI OSMO NANO STANDARD COMBO: CAPTURE AIRSOFT ACTION FROM EVERY ANGLE
For an airsoft player, every game is a unique experience to be shared and analyzed. The DJI Osmo Nano is designed to become your in-game witness, capturing your moves, tactics and successes with game-changing image quality and ease of use. Its minimalist format and magnetic attachment system allow you to integrate it into your equipment without hindering your movements, for a truly immersive first-person viewpoint.
Imagine being able to relive your games with the same level of detail and fluidity as the videos you watch online. Whether you're analyzing your strategies, creating content for your team or simply keeping a dynamic record of your days in the field, this action camera brings a new dimension to your airsoft practice.
PROFESSIONAL IMAGE QUALITY FOR ANALYSIS AND SHARING
The Osmo Nano is equipped with a 1/1.3" CMOS sensor, a remarkable size for a camera of this format. This technical feature enables it to capture 4K video at 60 frames per second and 35 megapixel photos. In play, this translates into exceptionally sharp footage, where every detail of the terrain, your cue and the movements of other players is perfectly rendered. The 10-bit D-Log M format offers an extended dynamic range, preserving information in shadows and highlights, essential for filming in the contrasting environments of a gaming venue.
STABILIZATION THAT DOESN'T WOBBLE, EVEN ON THE RUN
Fast movements, races between shelters and moving positions are no longer a problem for the quality of your video. RockSteady 3.0 stabilization technology combined withHorizonBalancing actively compensates for shocks and rotations. The result is a perfectly stable, horizontal image, even when you're running or in an uncomfortable position. You get usable footage that's pleasant to look at, without the blur and shakes that usually make action videos difficult to watch.
SEAMLESS INTEGRATION WITH YOUR TACTICAL EQUIPMENT
The Osmo Nano's main advantage for airsofters lies in its ultra-light 52-gram design and double-sided magnetic attachment system. In just a few seconds, you can attach it to your helmet visor, replica rail, plate-holder or suitable textile equipment. This polyethod of installation gives you total freedom to choose your angle of view, while ensuring that the camera remains securely in place during the action.
Its native 10-meter waterproofing protects it from weather, dust, mud and humidity - conditions frequently encountered outdoors. You don't have to worry about field conditions or a sudden downpour.
AUTONOMY AND MANAGEMENT FOR A DAY'S PLAY
With the camera alone, you benefit from around 90 minutes of autonomy. The Vision Dock included in this combo serves both as a control station with touch-sensitive OLED screen and as an additional battery, bringing total autonomy to over 200 minutes. In practice, this more than covers a typical day's airsoft with several games. You can easily recharge the camera between games via the dock, without the need for an electrical outlet in the field.
FAST STORAGE AND TRANSFER FOR EFFICIENT WORKFLOW
With 64 or 128 GB of internal memory (depending on version) and the option of adding a microSD card, you won't have to manage storage space in the middle of the action. After the game, the transfer of your footage is accelerated by the USB 3.1 connection offering speeds of up to 600 Mb/s. You can quickly save and edit your best moments without waiting hours for files to download.
The DJI Osmo Nano Standard Combo 64GB or 128GB is not just an accessory, it's a tool that documents and enhances your airsoft experience. It captures the reality of the game with the fidelity and stability needed to get the most out of it, whether your objective is tactical analysis, content creation or preserving dynamic memories of your exploits in the field.

KIT BASE PLATE ADHÉSIVE DJI OSMO : LA FIXATION STABLE POUR VOS PRISES DE VUE EN MOUVEMENT
Vous cherchez à capturer vos sessions d’airsoft ou vos entraînements tactiques avec un point de vue immersif et stable ? Le kit base plate adhésive et support bidirectionnel DJI est conçu pour cela. Il transforme votre équipement, comme un casque ou un bouclier, en un support de caméra fiable. Cet accessoire répond au besoin essentiel de fixer solidement une caméra d’action, telle que la DJI Osmo Action 6, sur des surfaces planes et rigides, même lors de déplacements rapides ou de contacts légers.
Oubliez les montages bancals ou les angles limités. Ce kit vous offre la liberté de positionner votre caméra pour des plans uniques, que ce soit pour analyser vos tactiques, créer du contenu dynamique ou simplement immortaliser vos parties. Sa conception est entièrement dédiée à une installation rapide et un maintien durable, pour que vous puissiez vous concentrer sur le jeu, pas sur votre matériel.
ADHÉSION HAUTE PERFORMANCE POUR UNE FIXATION DÉFINITIVE
La base plate utilise un adhésif haute performance conçu pour un maintien durable sur des surfaces propres, sèches et rigides. Son installation est simple : après nettoyage de la surface, il suffit d’appuyer fermement pendant 10 secondes et de laisser sécher 30 minutes avant usage. Cette procédure garantit une adhérence renforcée capable de résister aux vibrations et aux mouvements soutenus inhérents aux activités dynamiques.
En pratique, cela signifie que votre caméra reste solidement fixée à votre équipement tout au long d’une game. Que vous courriez, vous déplaciez en position basse ou simuliez une entrée dynamique, la fixation tient bon. Vous obtenez des séquences vidéo stables, sans tremblements intempestifs causés par un support qui bouge, pour un rendu visuel net et professionnel.
SUPPORT BIDIRECTIONNEL POUR UNE POLYVALENCE IMMÉDIATE
Le cœur du système est son support d’installation bidirectionnel à démontage rapide. Ce mécanisme vous permet de clipser et déclipser votre caméra Osmo en une seconde, sans outil. Mais sa vraie force réside dans la possibilité de changer l’orientation de l’optique instantanément. Vous pouvez ainsi passer d’un format portrait à un format paysage, ou simplement ajuster l’angle pour cadrer parfaitement votre champ de vision.
Sur le terrain, cette polyvalence est un atout majeur. Fixez la base sur le côté de votre casque pour un point de vue subjectif, puis basculez rapidement la caméra pour filmer vers l’avant ou sur le côté selon les besoins de la scène. Vous adaptez votre cadre à l’action en cours sans perdre de temps, capturant ainsi des perspectives variées et engageantes en un seul montage.
CONÇU POUR L’EXIGENCE DES ACTIVITÉS DYNAMIQUES
Ce kit n’est pas un simple accessoire, c’est une solution de montage pensée pour des conditions réelles d’utilisation. Sa résistance aux vibrations et aux chocs légers en fait un allié pour les joueurs d’airsoft qui veulent documenter leurs parties sans compromettre la sécurité de leur caméra. La fixation par vis incluse assure un assemblage solide entre la base et le support, éliminant tout jeu parasite.
Il est parfaitement compatible avec les modèles DJI Osmo Action 6 et DJI Osmo Nano. Son profil bas et discret s’intègre sur différents supports rigides, offrant une solution de fixation stable et presque invisible pour des prises de vue embarquées de qualité. Que vous souhaitiez filmer vos manœuvres, revivre les moments forts d’une partie ou créer du contenu pédagogique, ce kit fournit la base technique nécessaire pour des résultats constants.
UNE INSTALLATION SIMPLE POUR UN RÉSULTAT PROFESSIONNEL
La mise en œuvre est à la portée de tous. Choisissez une surface plane et rigide sur votre équipement, comme la partie haute d’un casque ou une plaque de protection. Après un nettoyage soigneux, posez la base adhésive et laissez-la agir. Une fois le support bidirectionnel fixé, votre caméra est prête à l’emploi. Le système de démontage rapide permet aussi de retirer votre matériel facilement pour le ranger ou le recharger.
Ce kit est la réponse pour les joueurs et passionnés qui refusent les solutions approximatives. Il apporte la fiabilité et la flexibilité nécessaires pour que la captation vidéo devienne une extension naturelle de votre équipement, et non une source de préoccupation. Vous investissez dans un système de fixation qui garantit que chaque moment d’action peut être enregistré avec clarté et stabilité.

Name: Osmo Action 6 Standard Combo Action Camera DJI
Description:
DESCRIPTION
DJI OSMO ACTION 6 STANDARD COMBO: CAPTURE THE INTENSITY OF YOUR GAMES IN PROFESSIONAL QUALITY
Documenting an airsoft game requires equipment that meets the demands of the terrain. The DJI Osmo Action 6 is designed for this demanding use. Whether you are in fast CQB, dense forest, or during a long milsim, this action camera records every detail with clarity and fluidity that preserves the authenticity of the action. Its native waterproofing of 20 meters and resistance to extreme temperatures make it a reliable tool, ready to face mud, rain, or cold without the need for a bulky housing.
Imagine being able to relive and analyze your fastest engagements in slow motion, or share the precision of your maneuver in ultra-smooth 4K video. With the Osmo Action 6, you are not just filming; you are archiving actionable evidence for your progress and community sharing.
IMAGE QUALITY SUITED FOR DYNAMIC AIRSOFT SCENARIOS
SENSOR AND FLUIDITY FOR FAST ACTION
The 1/1.1 inch square 38-megapixel sensor is the heart of this camera. This large sensor surface captures more light, which is crucial in the shaded environments of forests or in dimly lit interiors. Coupled with a variable aperture of f/2.0 to f/4.0, the camera automatically adjusts to changes in lighting, ensuring optimal exposure when transitioning from a dark building to a sunny clearing.
In play, this translates to sharp and detailed images, without overexposure or excessive digital ""noise."" The recording capability in 4K at 120 frames per second allows you to capture the fastest assaults with extreme fluidity. For tactical analysis or spectacular shots, the extreme slow-motion mode up to 960 fps in 1080p breaks down every moment, from the impact of a BB to the trajectory of your replica.
ADVANCED STABILIZATION FOR ALWAYS-READABLE FOOTAGE
Running, diving to the ground, quickly changing position: your movements during a game should not compromise the stability of your video. The Osmo Action 6 features RockSteady 3.0+ stabilization and especially the HorizonSteady mode. The latter keeps the horizon perfectly level even if the camera rotates on its axis, up to 4K/60p.
The benefit on the field is immediate. Your running sequences between cover or during an advance on rough terrain are perfectly stable and usable. The viewer focuses on the action and your strategy, not on shakes or a tilting frame. The footage becomes as professional as the game itself.
DESIGNED FOR ENDURANCE AND RESPONSIVENESS IN REAL CONDITIONS
BATTERY LIFE AND RESISTANCE TO THE ELEMENTS
A flat camera in the middle of a multi-hour milsim is useless. The DJI Osmo Action 6 is equipped with a 1950 mAh Extreme Battery Plus offering up to 4 hours of continuous recording under normal conditions. This battery life covers most sessions, even the longest. Additionally, its fast charging allows you to recover 80% of the battery in just 22 minutes during a break.
Its design goes further with a operating temperature range of -20°C to +45°C. Whether you play in winter or summer, the camera starts and operates without latency. The IP68 waterproofing (with housing) and the ability to dive up to 20 meters without any accessories protect it from sudden weather changes, water crossings, or simply sweat and dust.
INTUITIVE HANDLING AND ASSURED FRAMING
When the action heats up, you don't have time to navigate complex menus. The dual touch screen of the Osmo Action 6 solves this problem. The 1.46-inch front screen allows you to check your framing when the camera is facing you, essential for vlogs or pre-game checks. The 2.5-inch ultra-bright rear screen (1000 cd/m²) remains perfectly readable even in bright sunlight for precise parameter control.
Features like 5-minute pre-recording and automatic subject tracking act as insurance. The former starts recording even before you press the button, so you never miss the beginning of an engagement. The latter locks focus on a teammate or a moving target, freeing you mentally to focus solely on your game.
The DJI Osmo Action 6 Standard Combo is not just a camera. It is a tactical documentation tool that meets the specific constraints of airsoft. It transforms your gaming experience into high-fidelity content, for analysis, sharing, and memory of your most significant actions.

Name: Airsoft Camera HELMETCAM 2 RUNCAM
Description:
DESCRIPTION
THE RUNCAM HELMETCAM 2 AIRSOFT CAMERA, A FULL HD 60 FPS CAMERA WITH VIDEO FEEDBACK, 5 GHZ WI-FI AND 8-HOUR BATTERY LIFE
The RunCam HelmetCam 2 is an airsoft camera designed for use with tactical helmets. The aim is simply to film without disturbing the player or multiplying the number of manipulations. Its elongated format is a real plus in the field, remaining unobtrusive and easily placed on a helmet without protruding too far, while limiting the "block" effect often found on other, more compact formats.
On the capture side, the HelmetCam 2 records in Full HD 1920×1080 at up to 60 fps. The result is smoother rendering, and more adaptable editing. Videos are saved in MP4 format, a simple, universal format. Recording is done on a microSD card, with an announced capacity of up to 512 GB (exFAT format), so you can cover a whole day without worrying about storage.
The other real advantage is control and framing. The camera incorporates a 5 GHz Wi-Fi connection (standard 802.11 a/n/ac/ax), coupled with theRunCam App available on iOS and Android. This gives live video feedback to check the angle of the shot, adjust settings, and make sure everything is filmed properly. 5 GHz Wi-Fi is also relevant in busy environments, as it helps maintain a more stable connection than 2.4 GHz. The HelmetCam 2 uses an 18650 Li-ion 3500 mAh (3.7 V) battery offering up to around 8 hours of autonomy at 1080p/60 fps, and both recharging and connectivity are via USB-C.
For installation, RunCam provides several mounting solutions adapted to the helmet: velcro mount, slide rail mount and strap/tube mount, depending on the version. The idea is to provide a stable mounting while enabling the camera to be quickly repositioned to suit the helmet, mask or other preferences. The camera is water and dust resistant, so you can use it without fear.
The HelmetCam 2 is a camera that prioritizes efficiency, consistency and does exactly what you'd expect to capture essential moments during an airsoft game.

The Profile Turbofan goggle from ESS features an air evacuation system to prevent fogging. Fresh air circulates through the lower edge of the goggle frame thanks to a fan rotating at 13,000 rpm. The system is powered by a single 1.5-volt AA battery.

The Profile NVG Turbofan mask has a wide, open field of vision, it also has two spacers arranged on either side making it fully compatible with the wearing of Spectra or TC type helmets.

Like all ESS glasses, the interchangeable lenses are anti-fog and anti-scratch. They are made from 2.80 mm Polycarbonate.
