Name: Alignmentor Full-Size 40x40 Acetech electronic target
Description:
DESCRIPTION
PRESENTATION VIDEOS OF THE ACETECH ALIGNMENTOR FULL-SIZE 40X40 ELECTRONIC TARGET
THE ACETECH ALIGNMENTOR FULL-SIZE 40X40 ELECTRONIC TARGET, A PRECISE APPLICATION-DRIVEN ZEROING TOOL.
The Acetech Alignmentor Full-Size is an intelligent electronic target designed for precision adjustment of optics and hop-up in airsoft. It is aimed at players and practitioners who want to objectify their zeroing and training sessions, replacing conventional visual estimation with instant digital feedback on a smartphone or tablet. Where a paper target requires you to move around to see the impacts, the Alignmentor transmits the exact location of each ball directly to the user's screen, via a Wi-Fi connection with a range of up to 50 meters.
Construction and materials
The frame of the Alignmentor Full-Size is made of polycarbonate, a material renowned for its rigidity and impact resistance. The front cover, meanwhile, is made of glass-fiber-reinforced nylon, providing durability for repeated use. The impact-receiving face is made of polyurethane (PU), a flexible material chosen to absorb balls while enabling precise detection of the point of contact. The unit's modular design makes it easy to transport and assemble on site, whether indoors or out.
Operation and technology
The Alignmentor communicates via Wi-Fi with the AceSoft mobile app, compatible with Android 10.0 or higher and iOS 16.0 or higher. As soon as a ball hits the target, the impact is located and displayed in real time on the app's interface. A text-to-speech feedback system announces results aloud, allowing you to stay in shooting position without consulting the screen between each sequence. The application also incorporates configurable training modes and keeps a session history, useful for tracking progress or comparing successive settings. The target features integrated lighting, making it usable in low-light conditions. Power is supplied by a Li-Polymer battery rechargeable via a USB Type-C connector.
Compatibility and conditions of use
The Alignmentor Full-Size is exclusively compatible with 6 mm plastic airsoft paintballs. The use of 8 mm balls, 4.5 mm pellets, steel balls or plated balls weighing 0.50 g or more is explicitly discouraged and may damage the target. A minimum shooting distance of 3 meters is required for correct operation. Beyond 2 Joules at close range, the risk of damage is not covered by the warranty: this target is designed for set-up under controlled conditions, not for absorbing high-powered shots. The Full-Size model differs from the Compact version in its 40x40 dimensions, offering a larger detection surface, suitable for long-distance settings up to 50 meters.

Name: Balystik HPR200 US Ultra-Compact HPA Regulator
Description:
DESCRIPTION
THE BALYSTIK HPR200 HPA REGULATOR, A COMPACT AND PRECISE REGULATOR FOR HPA PLAYERS
The Balystik HPR200 is an HPA regulator designed to power HPA replicas and HPA-converted GBBR replicas. Made from aerospace-grade T6 aluminum, CNC-machined and anodized, it’s designed for players looking for durable, compact gear that’s ready to use right on the field. Weighing 155 grams and less than 6 cm tall, it fits seamlessly into a backpack setup without taking up much space.
Construction and Technology
The HPR200’s body is made entirely of CNC-machined aerospace-grade T6 aluminum, which provides high strength while keeping its weight to the bare minimum. Internally, the design features an ultra-lightweight piston paired with an oversized air intake. This technical choice promotes a high refresh rate across the entire adjustable pressure range, meaning the regulator quickly restores the set pressure after each firing cycle, even during sustained bursts. The internal design is also engineered for durability: only a single O-ring is used internally, which simplifies maintenance and minimizes potential points of failure. The HPR200 also stands out for its modularity, featuring a 360° rotating elbow and two outlets that allow it to simultaneously supply two HPA airsoft guns.
Adjustment, Safety, and Field Use
The HPR200’s output pressure is adjustable from 250 to 800 PSI, covering a wide range of applications. The built-in pressure gauge, calibrated from 0 to 200 PSI, allows for a direct reading of the current pressure. The Tournament Lock system mechanically locks the set pressure value, a feature particularly useful in situations where field rules prohibit any changes to power settings between matches. A rupture disk is built in as an overpressure safety feature: if the pressure limit is exceeded, this component fails before the regulator or the replica is damaged. The HPR200 is also compatible with the Balystik 12g CO2 adapter, provided the regulator is kept pointing upward when activating a CO2 cartridge.
Long-Term Reliability and Maintenance
Balystik, a French brand that has been in the HPA market for over 15 years, offers all HPR200 replacement parts separately: piston seal, piston, pressure gauge, rupture disk, adjustment wrench, adjustment screw, rupture disk nut, Tournament Lock clamp, and a complete maintenance kit. The availability of these components allows you to maintain or repair the regulator without having to replace the entire unit, which is a tangible long-term benefit.

Name: HPA XX-MOD System for Gearbox V2 MECHLABS
Description:
DESCRIPTION
THE XX-MOD FOR THE MECHLABS GEARBOX V2, A DROP-IN MECHANICAL HPA SYSTEM DESIGNED FOR CONVERSION AND PERFORMANCE
The XX-MOD HPA System for MECHLABS V2 Gearbox is a fully mechanical HPA system designed as a direct replacement for the V2 gearbox in an AEG replica. With no electronics whatsoever, it is intended for players seeking a reliable, adjustable HPA conversion system suited for demanding conditions, including humid environments. Its modular design, built-in 3-axis alignment, and numerous adjustment options make it a comprehensive system for those who want to fully harness the potential of a high-pressure air supply.
A CNC-machined aluminum construction, with no compromise on precision
The XX-MOD's body is made of CNC-machined Series 6 aluminum, anodized in one of the available colors. This choice of material ensures structural rigidity suitable for the mechanical stresses generated by the HPA system, while keeping the overall weight in check. The assembly is based on a modular block architecture with a precision lock-fit interface, ensuring a stable installation, whether during initial setup or after disassembly. The system incorporates 3-axis (XYZ) alignment, designed to accommodate dimensional variations between V2 receivers and ensure proper installation regardless of the platform in question.
Adjustments designed for shot control and air cycle synchronization
The XX-MOD features a magnetic trigger with adjustable travel and sensitivity, allowing the trigger feel to be tailored to the player's style. The XX-Mold bolt, the system's central component, features an adjustable nozzle for precise synchronization of the air cycle with the Hop-Up chamber based on its configuration and length. The Air Bender function allows you to modulate the internal cycle rate, providing direct control over the ROF and the system's overall dynamics. When firing in burst mode, the XX-MOD reduces air volume requirements and minimizes the "shot-down" effect observed during transitions between semi-auto and full-auto. Air consumption is also reduced compared to previous generations of MechLabs systems.
Complete waterproofing and extensive compatibility within the MechLabs ecosystem
The complete absence of electronics makes the XX-MOD fully waterproof: the system remains operational even when submerged underwater, without requiring any special precautions related to electronic components. This feature makes it particularly well-suited for scenarios in wet or aquatic conditions. In terms of compatibility, the XX-Mold bolt is cross-tech compatible with MechLabs' NEXXUS and ARC platforms, making it easy to integrate into a setup of replicas from this ecosystem. The system also supports a dual air supply configuration via MechLabs' FLO MAX TS regulator, for players who wish to optimize their air supply setup.

Name: HP-R SYSTEM HPA System for V3 Gearbox STORM AIRSOFT
Description:
DESCRIPTION
THE STORM AIRSOFT HPA HP-R SYSTEM FOR THE V3 GEARBOX: A TURNKEY ELECTROPNEUMATIC CONVERSION
The HPA HP-R SYSTEM from STORM AIRSOFT is an electropneumatic conversion kit designed to completely replace the internal mechanism of a V3 gearbox. It is intended for airsoft players who want to convert their AEG replica to HPA power while retaining both semi-automatic and full-auto firing modes. This type of conversion allows you to enjoy an electronically controlled system that offers more precise adjustments and is less prone to wear and tear on traditional moving parts.
An Electropneumatic System Designed for the V3 Gearbox
The HP-R SYSTEM is based on an electropneumatic architecture featuring a solenoid controlled by an FCU (Flight Control Unit) equipped with a digital display. This display provides direct access to settings without requiring external tools or complex adjustments. The kit is compatible exclusively with Version 3 gearboxes.

The system is powered by an 11.1V LiPo battery with T-Dean connectors. This is the only compatible battery type: no other technology or voltage should be used with this kit, in accordance with the manufacturer's specifications.
An adjustable nozzle to fit your setup
One of the distinctive technical features of this system is the ability to adjust the nozzle position using the shims included in the kit. This adjustment allows you to adapt the system to the replica's hop-up chamber, which is essential for ensuring proper BB feed and optimal air circuit sealing. The kit also includes a trigger board plate, a hose, a cable, and a trigger board washer, as well as installation and programming instructions to guide the user through every step of the integration process.
Who is this HPA system designed for?
The HP-R SYSTEM is an excellent choice for those seeking greater consistency in their shots, better control over their operating parameters, and a reduction in the mechanical wear inherent in traditional AEG systems. The inclusion of the FCU with a digital display offers a real advantage for intuitively configuring the system without needing a third-party app or equipment.

Description:
DESCRIPTION
PRESENTATION VIDEO OF THE HP-R
AN HPA KIT DESIGNED TO BE ACCESSIBLE TO ALL
The French brand STORM has designed a HPA conversion kit to convert your AEG airsoft replicas featuring a Gearbox V2 with rear wiring. They've designed it to be quick and easy to install for players with an AEG M4 or HK replica, for example.
The digital display supplied with the FCU makes setting up the replica much easier, offering a simple, uncluttered visual interface. This electropneumatic system also features a length-adjustable nozzle. To use the HP-R System, you'll need a LiPo 11.1v battery with T-Dean connector, to be purchased separately, to power the solenoid internally. This accessory will give you exceptional responsiveness and the ability to adjust the replica's power or rate of fire. To set up your HPA system you'll be able to access the following elements:
- PROFILE: Giving you access to the ability to set up two distinct profiles in the FCU
- Rate of Fire (ROF): Allows you to set the firing speed, measured in revolutions per second (RPS)
- SHOOTING MODE on first position: Varies between SEMI, BURST from 2 to 5 shots or BINARY trigger modes
- SHOOTING MODE on second position: Varies between FULL AUTO, SEMI, BURST from 2 to 5 shots or BINARY trigger modes
- NOZZLE DWELL: Determines how long the nozzle remains in the rearward position, allowing the loader to keep pace
- A-ST TIMEOUT: No need to modify this parameter according to the manual
- A-ST PULSE: No need to modify this parameter according to the manual either
.
This accessory is easy to maintain, since every 3000 rounds fired at most, you need to put a little silicone oil in the valve located on the air supply hose connected to the replica. The dematerialized user manual can be accessed via the QR code on the side of the box. This manual will give you access to all the information made available by STORM whether for product features, an installation guide, how to use the kit and how to maintain it.
This kit is perfect for upgrading your AEG replica to HPA without it being too expensive, and is much more accessible for neophytes to set up.

Name: Kit PULSAR D2 Rev.2 HPA System and TITAN II Expert Bluetooth GATE MOSFET
Description:
DESCRIPTION
THE PULSAR D2 HPA REV.2 AND TITAN II EXPERT BLUETOOTH GATE MOSFET KIT: A COMPLETE PACKAGE FOR UPGRADING TO AN HPA SYSTEM WITH PRECISION AND ADVANCED CONTROL
The PULSAR D2 HPA Rev.2 Kit with TITAN II Expert Bluetooth GATE MOSFET is a complete package combining a dual-solenoid HPA system and a Bluetooth MOSFET for AEG replicas. It is designed for players who want to convert their AEG replica to an HPA system without compromising on adjustment precision or versatility. The kit covers a velocity range of 250 to 650 FPS with a regulated rate of fire from 1 to 40 RPS, making it suitable for CQB, assault, and sniper configurations alike.
The PULSAR D2 HPA Rev.2 System: Dual Solenoid and Thoroughly Redesigned Architecture
The PULSAR D2 HPA Rev.2 is based on a dual-solenoid architecture, which separates the air supply from nozzle control. This technology offers two distinct operating modes: closed-bolt and open-bolt, depending on the type of replica or intended use. The acceptable pressure range extends from 60 to 140 PSI, and a single universal poppet covers the entire range, eliminating the need to replace any parts when changing power settings.
Revision 2 introduces several tangible design improvements. The piston is now made of aluminum, designed to maintain stable performance in both cold and high-temperature conditions, ranging from -15 °C to +50 °C. The tappet plate assembly has been completely redesigned to reduce friction and improve cycle stability. The nozzle return spring is centered, serving as a direct replacement for the original tappet plate spring. The 21.25 mm universal POM nozzle, included in the kit, is compatible with standard AEG nozzles, and when paired with AEG GATE nozzles, it has zero lateral play a feature particularly useful for ensuring a consistent ball feed.
The PULSAR weighs 95 g and measures 110 x 25.4 x 32 mm without the synchronization module, or 110 x 25.4 x 38.5 mm with it. It is one of the most compact dual-solenoid HPA systems available on the market.
Automatic cycle synchronization and optimized air consumption
One of the distinctive features of the PULSAR D2 HPA Rev.2 is its Auto Cycle Sync system: cycle synchronization is automatic, which significantly simplifies setup and reduces calibration time during assembly. This system, combined with the innovative BB feed system, makes the PULSAR less sensitive to internal assembly imperfections in the replica.
Air consumption is controlled: approximately 0.7 PSI per BB at 90 PSI with a 48 ci / 0.8 L 300 bar tank. In automatic mode, the PULSAR D2 shows no drop in rate of fire or velocity compared to semi-automatic mode, up to 40 RPS. Operation is also quieter than on the previous version. The solenoid supply voltage ranges from 5 to 8.4 V.
The TITAN II Bluetooth Expert MOSFET: Full replica control via app
The TITAN II Bluetooth Expert included in this kit is not just a simple protection MOSFET: it is a complete control module, compatible with the V2 e-HPA gearbox. It features Bluetooth 5.2 Low Energy connectivity and is controlled via the GCS (GATE Control Station) app, available on Android, iOS, Wear OS, watchOS, Windows, and macOS. Settings can be accessed in real time from a smartphone, tablet, PC, or smartwatch, including firmware updates.
Its features include a two-stage trigger, customizable selector modes, ROF control, sniper delay, an ammunition counter, serial safety limits, battery protection with alerts, an equalizer, as well as diagnostic tools and a built-in self-test. Its power supply accepts 5 to 8.6 VDC at a rated current of 10 A, with a current draw of 27 mA during operation and only 100 µA in low-power mode. The module weighs 28.2 g and measures 47.2 x 28.9 x 14.5 mm.
This kit is available with rear wiring.
In the dual-solenoid configuration, accessories requiring power via a dedicated power cable are not compatible. However, the TITAN II remains compatible with the GATE line of accessories designed for this configuration, including dual-solenoid HPA cables, universal I/O cables, the bolt catch with button and cable, and the magazine sensor with cable.

Name: Mosfet DTU V3 2.0 Bluetooth version for Gearbox V3 T238
Description:
DESCRIPTION
THE T238 MOSFET DTU V3 BLUETOOTH V2.0, ADVANCED WIRELESS FIRE CONTROL FOR V3 GEARBOXES
T238's Mosfet DTU V3 Bluetooth V2.0 is an electronic fire control unit designed for installation in V3 gearbox-equipped airsoft replicas. It is designed for players and technicians wishing to fine-tune their firing modes, protect their electronics and gain in reactivity, without having to repeatedly manipulate the replica. Its key asset: Bluetooth connectivity, enabling all functions to be set directly from a smartphone.
Electronic architecture designed for precision and durability
The DTU V3 Bluetooth V2.0 is based on a high-speed processor combined with two high-power mosfet chips, sized to absorb the current peaks inherent in rapid firing cycles. The unit incorporates eight optical sensors that detect the mechanical cycle without physical contact, replacing traditional mechanical switches. This approach reduces wear on switch-related parts and improves the accuracy of piston position detection. Voltage tolerance reaches 14.8V, making it compatible with high-capacity LiPo batteries commonly used in competition or intensive gaming.
Bluetooth programming: configure firing modes without opening the replica
Bluetooth connectivity is the element that clearly distinguishes this mosfet from its wired or push-button equivalents. Via a dedicated mobile app, users can access all firing settings without dismantling the replica. Three independently addressable firing selector positions: SAFE, SEMI and AUTO. Each can be assigned a specific firing mode, chosen from semi-automatic, double stroke (binary, i.e. one shot on trigger and one shot on trigger release), or burst. The SAFE and SEMI positions accept bursts of 3 to 6 shots. The AUTO position can be configured as full-auto, or in bursts of 3, 6 or 9 shots. This level of granularity makes it possible to adapt the replica's behavior to the game profile or rules of the field, without tools or disassembly.
Gearbox V3 compatibility and installation requirements
This mosfet is designed specifically for V3 gearboxes, used in particular in AK, G36 or Tavor replicas in airsoft configuration, as well as in certain Gel Ball Blasters equipped with the same mechanical architecture. T238 offers a separate version for V2 gearboxes: the two ranges are not interchangeable. Installation requires skills in soldering and electrical wiring. A qualified airsoft technician is recommended. Once installed, set-up is performed entirely from the smartphone, making subsequent adjustments accessible to any user, whatever their technical level.

- Increases the durability of the replica's switch

Name: MOSFET DTU V3 PRO Optical Sensor T238
Description:
DESCRIPTION
THE T238 DTU V3 PRO, A DIGITAL TRIGGER UNIT WITH OPTICAL SENSORS FOR V3 GEARBOXES
The T238 DTU V3 PRO (DTU = Digital Trigger Unit) is a digital trigger unitwith integrated MOSFET, designed to replace the mechanical contacts of a V3 gearbox. It is aimed atairsoft players equipped with AK or G36 replicas who require maximum responsiveness, long-term reliability and extensive control over firing modes. Its all-optical detection technology sets it apart from traditional contact solutions, eliminating wear-prone mechanical parts in the trigger and selector.
Non-contact optical technology: a principle that changes durability
The operation of the T238 DTU V3 PRO is based on infrared sensors that completely replace the usual electromechanical contacts. Both trigger and selector are detected optically, without any part being in permanent physical contact. This principle considerably extends the component's service life, with a claimed resistance of several million cycles.

The integrated MOSFET features ultra-low resistance, reducing energy losses in the power circuit and delivering the necessary current to the motor without excessive heating of the electronics. The wiring is made of high-temperature Teflon, a material suitable for thermally-charged environments.
Configurable firing modes and automatic calibration
The DTU V3 PRO features several directly programmable firing modes: semi-automatic, full-auto, binary trigger, 3-shot burst and Sniper Delay. A special "AUG" mode is also available: it enables semi-auto to be triggered on half a trigger pull, and full-auto on a full pull, reproducing the native behavior of Steyr AUG replicas.

The system is calibrated by automatic learning of the trigger stroke and selector position, enabling precise adaptation to the gearbox without manual adjustment of sensors. Pre-cocking is available to reduce the time lag between trigger pull and ball start.Active Brake stops the motor sharply after each cycle, improving control accuracy in semi-auto and limiting incomplete cycling.
Integrated electronic protection and battery compatibility
The DTU V3 PRO comes with four active protections: against motor short-circuit, gearbox lock-up, deep battery discharge and MOSFET overheating. These protections reduce the risk of material damage under conditions of intensive use or in the event of a mechanical incident.

The accepted voltage range extends from 6V to 16.8V, making the module compatible with 7.4V, 11.1V and 14.8V LiPo batteries. It is compatible with springs up to M150 ; above this value, a high-torque motor is recommended for correct operation. Reversing the polarity of the battery will cause permanent and irreversible damage to the PCB: it is imperative to respect the direction of connection. We also strongly advise against any physical modification of the PCB.

The DTU V3 PRO is designed for V3 gearboxes, with AK and G36 series being explicitly compatible. Matching selector stickers are supplied in two formats: 12 mm for AK replicas and 4.5 mm for G36s. An Auto-loading function is also integrated for motorized Gel Blaster magazines, with automatic activation one second after magazine insertion.

Name: Mosfet DTU Optique V1.7 - Gearbox V2 - Rear wiring - T238
Description:
DESCRIPTION
THE T238 DTU V2 PRO, AN ELECTRONIC TRIGGER UNIT WITH OPTICAL SENSORS FOR V2 GEARBOXES
The T238 DTU V2 PRO (DTU = Digital Trigger Unit) is an optical-sensing electronic trigger unit designed for V2 gearboxes (M4 / AR15 series) and split gearboxes. It is designed for airsofteers wishing to eliminate mechanical contacts from their replicas, as well as competitive players looking for advanced firing modes, and Gel Ball Blasters users. Its contactless architecture on the trigger tail and selector sets it apart from conventional MOSFETs, eliminating the wear points usually generated by repeated friction.
Non-contact detection for long-lasting reliability
The central principle of the T238 DTU V2 PRO is based on infrared sensors that read the position of the trigger tail and selector without any direct physical contact. This approach eliminates the electrical micro-arcing and mechanical wear that affect conventional contacts over the long term. The internal wiring is made of Teflon, a high-temperature resistant material that enhances the unit's durability in the face of intensive firing cycles and high-current motors. The unit is capable of withstanding a starting current of up to 300 A and an active braking current of up to 85 A, two figures that illustrate its ability to work with demanding motorizations.
Configurable firing modes and extended firing logic
The DTU V2 PRO comes with several firing modes: semi-automatic, full-auto, binary trigger (one shot on trigger, one shot on release), 3 Rounds Burst and Sniper Delay, which introduces a configurable delay between shots. An AUG mode is also available: an intermediate pull on the trigger triggers semi-auto, while a full pull switches to full-auto, allowing you to change cadence without touching the external selector. This flexibility of configuration makes it a relevant choice for users wishing to adapt their replica to different game formats without additional mechanical modification. The pre-cocking function and Active Brake complete the package, reducing firing latency and stopping the piston precisely at the end of the cycle.
Integrated protection and technical compatibility
The T238 DTU V2 PRO incorporates a five-level protection system covering motor short-circuit, gear locking, excessive battery discharge and MOSFET overheating. These devices make the unit usable even by less experienced profiles, securing the replica's components against common handling errors. The accepted voltage range extends from 6 V to 16.8 V, offering compatibility with the majority of LiPo batteries available on the market. For assemblies exceeding an M150 spring, we recommend the use of a suitable High-Torque motor. Connecting a battery with reversed polarity can cause permanent and irreversible damage: this must be checked before any power-up. The unit is available in two wiring configurations, Front-wired and Rear-wired, to suit different M4 replica architectures. An intelligent self-charging function is also available for Gel Ball Blasters equipped with an internal motor charger.

Name: Mosfet DTU Bluetooth Gearbox V2 T238
Description:
DESCRIPTION
MOSFET DTU BLUETOOTH GEARBOX V2 T238, ELECTRONIC FIRE CONTROL PROGRAMMABLE WITHOUT DISASSEMBLY
The Mosfet DTU Bluetooth Gearbox V2 T238 is an electronic fire control unit designed for version 2 gearboxes in both AEG airsoft replicas and Gel Ball Blasters. It's aimed at shooters and technicians who want to fine-tune their replica's firing parameters via a smartphone app, without having to reopen the gearbox for each adjustment. This level of control, combined with active protections against overheating and low voltage, makes it a serious internal component for long-lasting installation.
Technical architecture geared to precision and reliability
The DTU V2 T238 is based on a high-speed processor combined with 8 optical sensors, which ensure fine, continuous detection of the firing cycle. This density of sensors enables precise reading of piston position at all times, which directly conditions pre-cocking quality and trigger reactivity. Two high-power mosfet chips manage motor control, with the aim of reducing wear on mechanical contacts and maintaining clean electrical commutation over time.
Overheating protection operates autonomously: if the unit overheats, an audible alarm is triggered, and the system restarts automatically after cooling down. Low-voltage protection is set to 7.4 V by default, and is signalled by 4 distinct beeps, allowing you to intervene before damaging the battery or degrading shooting performance.
Bluetooth programming and configurable firing modes
Bluetooth connectivity is the central feature of this DTU. It enables settings to be changed directly from a smartphone, without having to remove the power supply or dismantle the replica. Pre-cocking, which determines the position of the piston at the end of the cycle in semi-automatic mode, is remotely adjustable, as are the firing modes.
Available modes include semi-automatic, burst configurable from 3 to 6 shots on the Safe or Semi positions, from 3 to 9 shots on Auto, as well as a Binary Trigger mode (double stroke single shot), which triggers one shot when the trigger is pressed and another when it is released. This flexible configuration is ideal for a wide range of field applications, from urban play to games requiring precise cadence control.
V2 gearbox compatibility and Auto-loading function
The DTU V2 T238 is designed specifically for version 2 gearboxes, the format used on a large proportion of AEG M4, M16, MP5 and similar replicas. It is also compatible with Gel Ball Blasters using the same architecture, thus extending its field of application.
An Auto-loading function is integrated for motorized Gel Ball Blaster magazines: when the magazine is changed, the motor is automatically activated for 0.5 seconds, ensuring that the balls are loaded without further manual intervention.
Installation of this mosfet involves welding and wiring. It is recommended for technicians with proven experience in airsoft electronics, or specialized workshops.

Name: G5 Plus Smart Long Gearbox V2 Brushless Motor GATE
Description:
DESCRIPTION
THE G5 PLUS SMART LONG GEARBOX V2 GATE BRUSHLESS MOTOR: A SMART, PROGRAMMABLE MOTOR FOR V2 GEARBOXES
The G5 Plus Smart Long Gearbox V2 GATE brushless motor is a high-performance brushless electric motor designed specifically for AEG replicas equipped with a V2 gearbox. It's designed for players who want to optimize their build, with precise control over speed, torque, and responsiveness--all managed via a mobile app. Whereas a standard brush motor imposes fixed settings, the G5 Plus Smart allows for fully adjustable parameters in real time, without any additional tools.
An expanded performance range, controlled via the app
The most distinctive feature of the G5 Plus Smart Long is its native programmability via the GCS (Gate Control Station) app, available on Android, iOS, Windows PCs, and macOS, as well as on Wear OS- and watchOS-compatible smartwatches. When paired with a GATE TITAN II Bluetooth or GATE ASTER II Bluetooth MOSFET, the motor enters "Smart" mode: the rotational speed is then adjustable from 10,000 to 46,000 rpm, and the torque can be configured according to the build's requirements. At 11.1 V, the no-load speed reaches 45,800 rpm, maximum torque is 2,334 g/cm, and the maximum power measured by GATE is 519 W. These values are measured under specific conditions and should be interpreted based on the actual supply voltage used.
The motor supports a supply voltage range from 6 V to 16.8 V, making it compatible with both standard LiPo setups and high-voltage configurations. The GCS app also allows you to adjust settings during a match, directly from a smartphone, without interrupting gameplay and without connecting an external programmer. This flexibility is particularly useful for adapting the motor's behavior to changing gameplay conditions or different firing profiles.
A technical design engineered for reliability and smooth operation
The G5 Plus Smart Long's motor shaft is CNC-machined and integrated directly into the motor. The pinion is a Type D, standard in AEG setups. The motor connectors are reinforced to withstand the stresses associated with high inrush currents, particularly during high-power load peaks.
The motor incorporates a backstop mechanism, independent of the one in the gearbox, which GATE recommends keeping in place. This internal backstop contributes to smooth rotation, reduced operating noise, and precise pre-cocking. It can be added without replacing the gearbox's existing mechanical protections. The Long version shown here measures 88.5 x 29.5 x 25 mm and weighs 140 g, dimensions that are compatible with the long motor mounts on standard V2 gearboxes.
Smart Features and Compatibility with the GATE Ecosystem
Two distinct functions allow you to tailor the motor's behavior to your playing style. The Soft Start function reduces mechanical stress during startup by limiting the initial torque peak, which extends the lifespan of the gears. The Fast Start function, conversely, maximizes trigger responsiveness for minimal response time between pulling the trigger and the first BB being fired.
The G5 Plus Smart Long is also compatible in "Standard" mode (without advanced programming) with the GATE ASTER SE MOSFETs for V2, GATE ASTER SX for V2, and first-generation GATE TITAN V2. In this configuration, the motor operates like a conventional brushless motor, without access to RPM or torque settings via the GCS app. To take full advantage of all the smart features, pairing with a GATE TITAN II Bluetooth or a GATE ASTER II Bluetooth is required.
Efficiency and Power Consumption: Concrete Data for a Well-Controlled Build
At 11.1 V, the G5 Plus Smart Long achieves a maximum efficiency of 75.9%, reached at a speed of 40,987 RPM with a current of 24.9 A and a torque of 500 g/cm. This high efficiency translates to reduced battery consumption and lower heat generation compared to an equivalent brushed motor--two direct benefits for extended gaming sessions. The GCS app also includes DTC (Diagnostic Trouble Codes) reading and automatic motor detection, which simplifies diagnostics and monitoring of the motor's condition without the need for disassembly.

The T238 BL-480 is an AEG brushless motor designed for players looking for a responsive, high-speed, fine-tunable upgrade solution for electric replicas. Available in long-axis or short-axis versions, it is designed for gearbox V2 and V3 compatible platforms, depending on replica configuration. Its main attraction lies in the combination of 3-phase sensorless brushless technology, integrated speed control from 50 to 100% and several electronic protections, making it an appropriate basis for CQB, DMR or speedsoft assemblies, depending on the level of speed required.

Name: Influx AVS Ballistic Protective Mask ESS
Description:
DESCRIPTION
THE INFLUX AVS BALLISTIC PROTECTIVE MASK: CERTIFIED PROTECTION DESIGNED FOR DEMANDING ENVIRONMENTS
The Influx AVS ballistic protective mask is developed by ESS, a leading brand in the field of military and tactical eye protection equipment. It is intended for airsoft players operating in dynamic environments, exposed to dust, humidity, or fog, who cannot afford to lose visual clarity during a mission. Its design is based on two patented systems, multi-standard ballistic certification, and versatile wear options designed to integrate seamlessly with a full set of personal protective equipment.
A ballistic polycarbonate lens, certified to four stringent standards
The Influx AVS visor is made of 3 mm-thick polycarbonate, a significant thickness for this category of goggles. It holds four certifications: U.S. MIL SPEC MIL-PRF-32432, ANSI Z87.1-2010, OSHA, and CE EN166 BT. These certifications attest to impact resistance that meets U.S. and European military standards, giving this goggle genuine credibility for intensive field use. The outer surface of the lens features a scratch-resistant coating, while the inner surface incorporates an anti-fog coating--two complementary finishes that preserve visual clarity over time. The goggles also provide full protection against UVA and UVB rays, without optical distortion.
The AVS system and the Roto-Clip: two wearing modes, tool-free tint change
The heart of the Influx AVS lies in the combination of two distinct systems. The AVS (Adjustable Ventilation System) allows you to switch between a fully ventilated mode, which promotes airflow and prevents fogging, and a sealed mode that ensures effective dust filtration. This adjustment is made directly on the goggles, depending on field conditions. The Roto-Clip system, meanwhile, allows you to change the lens without any tools, in just a few seconds. Two lenses are included as standard: a clear lens with 90% visible light transmission (VLT 90%, CE certified 2C-1,2 1 BT K N), ideal for low-light environments or nighttime use, and a smoky gray screen with 15% light transmission (VLT 15%, CE certified 5-3.1 1 BT K N), suitable for direct sunlight. This pair covers all situations encountered in the field without requiring an additional mask.
Ergonomics, Compatibility, and Versatility
The inner OpFoam headband with antimicrobial treatment ensures a comfortable fit over time, even during sustained physical exertion. The pivoting strap fasteners allow for precise adjustment to the wearer's head shape and facilitate wear over military or tactical helmets, thanks to a design compatible with standard suspension systems. The Influx AVS is also designed to work with night vision systems and can accommodate U-Rx and UPLC Rx corrective optical inserts, making it suitable for players who wear contact lenses or glasses. This ballistic goggle integrates seamlessly into a military or tactical gear setup.
